job.job_description:
We are looking for a hands-on Vulnerability Remediation Engineer having 8+ years of experience who has strong practical experience with SAST, SCA, DAST, secure coding, vulnerability remediation, and AI Agent workflows.

Key Responsibilities

* Analyze and remediate vulnerabilities identified through SAST, SCA, and DAST tools.

* Leverage GenAI to automate vulnerability triaging and remediation workflows.

* Develop Agent Skills for AI coding agents such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and Cursor.

* Evaluate and validate AI-generated fixes for security, correctness, regression risk, and remediation effectiveness.

Required Skills

* Strong programming experience in two or more languages like Java, C#, JavaScript, Python, or C++ along with their respective package managers, third-party libraries, and ecosystems.

* Strong experience in vulnerability analysis, remediation, secure coding, and application security.

* Hands-on experience with SAST, SCA, and DAST tools and understanding of vulnerability findings, root-cause analysis, and remediation.

* Good understanding of OWASP, MITR, CVEs/CWEs, CVSS, and common application security vulnerabilities.

* Experience developing Agent Skills for GitHub Copilot/Claude Code/Cursor.

* Good understanding of Generative AI Fundamentals, Prompt Engineering, Agentic AI workflows.
